scope: Pinned Clover SDK source and CLI parser audit only; no model load or inference.

source_observations.finding: draft-self uses the target context, builds a masked noncausal block, selects argmax draft tokens, then restores causal/recurrent/KV state. Failed drafting can fall back without a draft; successful generation alone does not prove drafting was active.
The documented Clover example uses llama-speculative-simple with n-max15, acceptance-ratio0.9, delta0.6 and BF16 KV; it is not a llama-server invocation.

Acceptance-ratio/delta CLI options are registered for the speculative example, while draft type/n-max also support the server. Actual server parser accepts draft-self with --help but rejects acceptance-ratio before any model load.
n_decode_total explicitly excludes speculative and multimodal work. Draft/accepted token and verification-step counters are separate and do not enumerate every internal forward graph.

qualification: Static type/flag support is confirmed; target self-draft execution, output equivalence, acceptance behavior and complete compute accounting remain unqualified.
next_gate: Do not label existing causal-AR benchmark results as diffusion/self-speculative results.
Before a self-draft quality/efficiency comparison, use an appropriate driver with explicitly pinned acceptance semantics, and count masked drafting plus causal verification and rollback work.
Require nonzero actual drafting/acceptance evidence and reject silent fallback as successful mode qualification.
Do not substitute server n_decode_total for total model forwards or GPU-seconds.
Existing meter.cpp rejects speculative mode and its queued target probes qualify only causal AR.
verification: Two CLI-only parser probes completed (expected exit0 and exit1); no checkpoint, source, build or running validation configuration changed.
